# Patreon

> > Patreon is a membership platform that enables creators to build sustainable income through direct fan support and community engagement.

Patreon connects creators with their communities through subscription-based memberships, offering tools for content distribution, community management, and monetization. The platform integrates with services like Discord and Spotify to enhance creator-fan relationships.

## Key Topics

- Patreon membership platform
- Creator monetization
- Fan communities
- Collections content organization
- Discord integration
- Spotify integration
- Subscription tiers
- Creator tools
- Community features
- Press and media
- Brand assets
- Creator platform ecosystem

## Press and Media
